transcript: This free AI tool lets you clone any website with just a single screenshot. It's called Screenshot to Code and it's a fully open source project with over 72,000 stars on GitHub. You just drop in a screenshot and it'll read the layout, the spacing, the fonts, the colors, and even build the entire website for you live. And it works on more than just screenshots. You can give it a Figma design, reference images, or even a screen recording of a site and it'll turn that thing into a fully working prototype in minutes. Plus, you'll also get a live canvas so you can tweak anything however you want. Want to try this for yourself? Just comment "Website" down below and I'll send you guys the links directly.
